profile.headline: Software Engineer 3 at Haas Automation, Inc.
profile.summary:
Computer Science graduate from the University of California, Santa Barbara. Post-grad endeavours have included developing my side projects, broadening my knowledge in best software development practices, and contributing to my company's CNC technology. My long-term goal is to contribute to the development of a successful video game software and system.

Currently working as a software engineer at Haas Automation Inc, developing their CNC machine technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
• Constructing solutions through analysis, problem definition, requirement generation and implementation of proposed solutions.
• Writing documentation and supporting diagrams supporting solutions.
• Preparing and installing source code into source control by determining compliance of software changes with system specifications, programming best practices, and ensuring these changes are free from defects.
• Improving workflow by conducting analysis, and recommending changes in policies and procedures to management.
• Creating bug reports through investigation and by collecting, and analyzing data, and providing clear documentation on reproduction of observed issues.

positions.title: Mobile Application Programmer
positions.description:
• Partnered with university research team to design and integrate a data collection service for research field work.
• Directly lead discussions and meetings related to hardware and software considerations weekly.
• Conducted quality assurance on application specifications and design.

positions.title: Ticket Office Assitant
positions.description:
• Interacted directly with Arts & Lectures hospitality technological system to provide courteous ticket selling services.
• Provided detailed, in-depth information related to the variety of shows presented during the season, and which seats would serve best for the specified show and venue.
• Contributed to the administrative needs of the department through various bookkeeping duties related to patron information and sales.
• Acted as a consistent contact point for all inquiries directed towards the ticket office department related to shows, sales, and seating availability.

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description:
• Tasked with managing a university-owned website for the UCSB Sociology department.
• Cooperated in a small team to design implementation strategies for client requested features.
• Developed and maintained functionality of site through Drupal content management system using CSS, Javascript, and HTML.

positions.title: Dining Service Associate
positions.description:
• Provided fast, courteous, and efficient service to customers.
• Followed proper product handling procedures as instructed by a Supervisor or Manager.
• Responsible for the safe transportation and delivery of materials and food products.
• Tasked with retaining records of food produced, ingredient stocks, and on-campus food requests.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Theta Nu Kappa Multicultural and Academic Fraternity, Inc.
volunteerExperiences.description: I acted as the main liaison for the alumni and active members of the fraternity chapter. I worked towards collecting contact info for alumni and assisted the VP of Administration in maintaining and updated rosters. Other forms of duty included keeping a record of important dates and initiation ceremonies, creatively applying graphics design knowledge to promote social media presence, updating the fraternity website (which I created from the ground up) utilizing HTML and CSS through a WCMS.

company.name: Theta Nu Kappa Multicultural and Academic Fraternity, Inc.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Theta Nu Kappa, Multicultural & Academic Fraternity, Inc.
volunteerExperiences.description: During my undergraduate career, I actively participated in organizing philanthropy events related to mental health awareness. All proceeds gathered throughout my organization's Week of Mental Health Awareness are donated to a local care center, the Sanctuary Centers of Santa Barbara. Among our philanthropic efforts, my organization strove to promote diversity among our community and uphold academic excellence and success among our members.
